rationale: Human presence directly subtracts an environmental effect from a continuous field: tracking creates a dry volume around visitors while rain continues everywhere else.
notes: The official page documents water, solenoid valves, custom software and 3D tracking cameras; visitors navigate a continual downpour while human presence prevents rain from falling locally.

decision.rationale: Canonical example of presence-mediated negative space: interaction changes the environment around the participant rather than adding a UI object in front of them.
